# send_conversation_invitation_tool

> Send an email invitation to a user to join and respond to an LLM conversation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `communication` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=send_conversation_invitation_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Send an email invitation to a user to join and respond to an LLM conversation. The user will receive a single-use link that allows them to send one message to continue the conversation.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
- This is for SINGLE-MESSAGE FEEDBACK (one response only, then token expires)
- Use send_guest_invitation_tool for MULTI-MESSAGE GUEST TRIAL (allows viewing full conversation and sending multiple messages based on config)
- This tool is ideal for asking specific questions or requesting one-time input
- Guest invitation tool is ideal for trial experiences and progressive engagement

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | Email address to send the invitation to. |
| `message` | string | yes | Message to include for the recipient explaining what input is needed. |
| `llm_conversation_id` | number | no | Optional if this tool was used in the scope of an LlmConversation it will use that LlmConversations Id, if not this must be passed. |
